judge.rationale: The core validation implementation in `src/orchestration/tools/registry.ts` works properly—it compiles schemas at registration time, caches dynamic schemas in a `WeakMap`, and formats rejection errors without leaking input values. However, the candidate appears to have stopped mid-flight (leaving `.lore/dod.md` committed with unchecked items). Consequently, it is missing required documentation updates in `README.md`, `docs/adding-a-tool.md`, `.specify/spec.md`, and `example/weather-tool.ts`, as well as an incomplete `CHANGELOG.md` entry. It also placed most tests in an unrequested `registry.acceptance.test.ts` file rather than `registry.test.ts` and `chatOrchestrator.test.ts`, and omitted unit tests for extra properties pass-through, dynamic schema updates, static compilation count, and unknown tool throws.
